assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for Moss & Ember
Primary request: An original portrait for Cinder Host, a larger classic swarm of fifteen little ember sprouts from the valley. Make it read instantly as a lively group of tiny separate creatures, not as one large flame.
Scene/backdrop: A softly blurred ash bed outside a small riverside foundry, with dark timber, a few copper kiln details, moss, and warm workshop light.
Subject: Exactly fifteen small ember-sprout creatures gathered together in three loose depth layers. Use the same broad family traits as Moss & Ember's tiny ember sprouts: seed-shaped charcoal-brown bodies, stubby root feet, modest nutshell caps, and bright warm cores. Give the front group several clear silhouettes and let the others form a dense, cheerful swarm behind them; individual faces do not need to be countable at thumbnail size.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted 2.5D game-card illustration with softly sculpted forms, broad controlled brushwork, matte materials, and simplified details that stay distinct when small.
Composition/framing: Close square group portrait, the swarm fills the center with a generous edge margin; keep the clustered mass clearly made of many little sprouts, without a single oversized leader.
Lighting/mood: Gentle amber kiln light with soft moss-green and ash-gray shadows; lively and warm.
Color palette: Ember amber, muted rust, charcoal ash, moss green, weathered copper, and dark wood.
Materials/textures: Soot-softened seed husks, small nutshell caps, tiny root stems, subtle copper workshop details, painted ash and moss.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Keep each creature small and visibly separate in the group silhouette. No labels, letters, numbers, logos, UI, frame, border, watermark, weapons, or humanoid armor.
Avoid: One giant flame, fireball, explosion, fiery trail, outward blast, copied commercial game art or characters, photorealism, glossy plastic, flat vector art, text.
